zh: description: "`com.open.alpha2` 裝在 UBTECH Alpha2 機械人 (Android 5.1.1, API 22) 上的本地控制面板 HTTP + WebSocket API。 依 `MainActivity handleApi()` / `HttpServer` 反向生成， 覆蓋機械人全部本機能力（原 17 個 AIDL interface 功能，現經直驅實現），加上獨立的 system/xiaozhi/stream/upload 命名空間。 預設由 `HttpServer.PORT = 8888` 以純 HTTP 提供 (`http://:8888/`)，同 WiFi 任何瀏覽器可直接訪問。 所有 `/api/*` 回應皆為 `application/json; charset=utf-8` 的 `{ok: boolean, ...}` 形狀，失敗時帶 `error` 欄位。401 一律附 `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="panel"`。 即時事件 (觸摸/ASR/電池/跌落/PIR 等) 經 `GET /ws` (RFC6455 WebSocket) 推送，非輪詢。 實驗 tab 另有 opt-in 面板 token (`/api/system/auth/*`，見 PanelAuth.java)：預設關閉（全開）； 啟用後成個面板上鎖——全部 `/api/*`（含讀操作、其他分頁、Blockly）、全部 `/upload/*`、 `/stream/*` 同 `/ws` 要帶認證（`Authorization: Bearer ` 主；設不到 header 的 ``／WebSocket 用 `?panel_token=` fallback），缺／錯回 401；淨 `system/auth/*` （解鎖入口）同靜態頁開放。Token 記喺瀏覽器 localStorage（同一個面板地址跨 tab 共用）。 舊 `?token=` 別名已移除（同小智 ota `token` 撞名），curl 請用 `-H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` 或 `?panel_token=`。 ",
en: description: "The local control panel of `com.open.alpha2` on the UBTECH Alpha 2 robot (Android 5.1.1, API 22), the HTTP + WebSocket API. Generated from `MainActivity handleApi()` / `HttpServer`, it covers all local robot capabilities (the original 17 AIDL interface functions, now by direct drive), plus the separate system/xiaozhi/stream/upload namespaces. By default it is served as plain HTTP on `HttpServer.PORT = 8888` (`http://:8888/`), reachable by any browser on the same WiFi. All `/api/*` answers are `application/json; charset=utf-8` of the `{ok: boolean, ...}` shape, with an `error` field on failure. A 401 always carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="panel"`. Live events (touch/ASR/battery/fall/PIR and more) are pushed over `GET /ws` (RFC6455 WebSocket), not polled. The experiment tab has an opt-in panel token (`/api/system/auth/*`, see PanelAuth.java): off by default (fully open); when enabled the whole panel is locked — all `/api/*` (read calls, other pages, Blockly included), all `/upload/*`, `/stream/*` and `/ws` need authentication (`Authorization: Bearer ` first; where a header is not possible, `/WebSocket use the `?panel_token=` fallback), a missing or wrong token returns 401; only `system/auth/*` (the unlock entry) and the static pages stay open. The token is kept in browser localStorage (shared across tabs of the same panel address). The old `?token=` alias is removed (name clash with the Xiaozhi ota `token`), use `-H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` with curl or `?panel_token=`. ",

zh: summary: 取消進行中的 Vosk 模型下載
en: summary: Cancel the running Vosk model download

zh: summary: 控制單顆舵機角度（cmd05 單發；可選連 trim 經 cmd12 寫入 chest EEPROM）
en: summary: Control one servo angle (cmd05 single send; optional trim write to chest EEPROM via cmd12)

zh: description: 只動目標一粒。trim 有帶就接著寫入（掉電保持，亂寫會改出廠校準；掃描驗證）。17/18 號手指天生無回授，trim 寫入會報失敗
en: description: Moves only the target one. If a trim is carried it is written after (kept after a power cut, a wrong write changes the factory calibration; scan to verify). Servos 17 and 18 (fingers) have no feedback by nature, so a trim write reports failure

zh: description: 偏差值（signed），經 cmd12 寫入 chest EEPROM 並掉電保持；不帶就僅動角度
en: description: Offset value (signed), written to chest EEPROM via cmd12 and kept after a power cut; absent = move the angle only

zh: description: 結果（含 trim 寫入狀態）
en: description: Result (with the trim write state)

zh: description: true = 已送出但回覆被搶食（未知寫入否，重新掃描驗證；實測零 ACK 照存入）
en: description: true = sent but the reply was eaten (write success unknown, rescan to verify; in testing zero ACK still stores it)

zh: summary: 同時控制全部舵機（20 或 22 顆）
en: summary: Control all servos at once (20 or 22)

zh: description: 20（舵機 1-20）或 22（舵機 1-22）個逗號分隔角度；20 相容舊客戶端只動 1-20，22 前 20 走 cmd3、21/22 各補一發 cmd05
en: description: 20 (servos 1-20) or 22 (servos 1-22) comma-separated angles; 20 is for old clients and moves only 1-20, 22 uses cmd3 for the first 20 and adds one cmd05 each for 21 and 22

zh: summary: 實際讀取單顆舵機 trim（胸 cmd13 live query，官方 tuner 同款）
en: summary: Read one servo trim for real (chest cmd13 live query, same as the official tuner)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 05 00 0d <id> 讀 chest 存住的偏差原值（官方角:偏 = 1:3），不是絕對角度；8 號例：位姿 65 下橫跨多次讀數恒為 -33。讀不到（超時／舵機回 01 error，如本機 5/6 號硬件壞；17/18 號手指天生無回授）報 ok:false。commanded 是命令位姿追踪值，僅供參考
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 05 00 0d <id> to read the offset value the chest stores (official angle to offset is 1 to 3), not the absolute angle; example servo 8, at pose 65, reads -33 across many reads. A read failure (timeout, or the servo answers 01 error, such as hardware-bad 5 and 6 on this unit; fingers 17 and 18 have no feedback by nature) reports ok:false. commanded is the commanded-pose track value, for reference only

zh: description: trim 實際讀取值（或讀失敗）
en: description: Trim value read for real (or a read failure)

zh: description: chest 存住的偏差原值 signed（成功先有）
en: description: The offset value the chest stores (signed; present on success)

zh: description: 命令位姿追踪值（可 null），僅供參考
en: description: Commanded-pose track value (may be null), for reference only

zh: summary: 逐顆實際讀取全部 22 軸 trim（tuner 掃描 offset 用，官方節奏約十幾 ms 一粒）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of trim for real, one by one (for the tuner offset scan; the official pace is about ten or so ms per servo)

zh: description: 22 軸 trim 原值；讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed
en: description: 22 axes of trim values; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed

zh: summary: 實際讀取單顆舵機絕對角度（胸 cmd6 live query）
en: summary: Read one servo absolute angle for real (chest cmd6 live query)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 00 00 06 <id> 讀即時角度（同 servo/one 同單位；跟位實測誤差約 1°）。注意不是 servo/read 那個 trim/偏差。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 00 00 06 <id> to read the live angle (same unit as servo/one; a follow-up test shows an error of about 1 degree). Note this is not the trim or offset of servo/read. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false

zh: description: 絕對角度實際讀取值（或讀失敗）
en: description: Absolute angle value read for real (or a read failure)

zh: description: 即時絕對角度（成功先有）
en: description: Live absolute angle (present on success)

zh: summary: 讀單顆舵機絕對角度並即寫回上力（原子操作）
en: summary: Read one servo absolute angle and write it back with torque at once (one atomic step)

zh: description: 先 cmd6 實際讀取（會鬆開那顆），即用 servo/one（cmd05）寫回同一個位上力，全程後端內完成。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false 且不寫回
en: description: First cmd6 reads for real (this releases that servo), then servo/one (cmd05) writes back the same position with torque, all inside the backend. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false and does not write back

zh: description: 絕對角度＋有無寫回上力（或讀失敗）
en: description: Absolute angle, and whether torque was written back (or a read failure)

zh: description: 有無即寫回上力（成功先有）
en: description: Whether torque was written back at once (present on success)

zh: summary: 連讀 22 軸絕對角度，每粒即寫回上力（100ms 間隔）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of absolute angle in a row, writing each back with torque (100ms apart)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd6 實際讀取＋即 servo/one 寫回同位（讀會鬆開那顆，寫回即上力；單粒已證實無鬆無動，22 連讀實測中）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed，且不寫回
en: description: Per servo cmd6 reads for real, plus servo/one writes back the same position (a read releases that servo, writing back sets torque; one servo is confirmed no-release no-move, the 22 in a row is under test). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed, and not written back

zh: description: 22 軸即時角度＋逐顆有無寫回；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of live angles, and per servo whether written back; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

zh: description: 恆 true（即時讀數）
en: description: Always true (a live reading)

zh: description: 逐顆有無即寫回上力
en: description: Per servo whether torque was written back at once

zh: summary: 實際讀取單顆舵機回讀角度（胸 cmd23/0x17 live query，PC 工具「讀角度 6」同款）
en: summary: Read one servo read-back angle for real (chest cmd23/0x17 live query, same as the PC tool read angle 6)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 00 00 17 <id> 讀即時角度（同 servo/one 同單位；跟 0x06 同級，未驗證誤差）。注意不是 servo/read 那個 trim/偏差。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false。0x17 會唔會鬆舵機未知——呢個 endpoint 純讀唔寫回，實測中
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 00 00 17 <id> to read the live angle (same unit as servo/one; same class as 0x06, error not verified). Note this is not the trim or offset of servo/read. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false. Whether 0x17 releases the servo is unknown - this endpoint is read only and writes back nothing, under test

zh: description: 回讀角度實際讀取值（或讀失敗）
en: description: Read-back angle value read for real (or a read failure)

zh: description: 即時回讀角度（成功先有）
en: description: Live read-back angle (present on success)

zh: summary: 連讀 22 軸回讀角度（cmd23/0x17，無間隔，純讀唔寫回）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of read-back angle in a row (cmd23/0x17, no interval, read only and no write back)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd23 實際讀取，一次過 22 粒（無間隔、唔重試、不寫回；實測 20 粒 230ms 全中，21/22 真機證實有回授）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed
en: description: Per servo cmd23 reads for real, all 22 in one pass (no interval, no retry, no write back; in testing all 20 hit in 230ms, 21 and 22 confirmed to have feedback on a real unit). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed

zh: description: 22 軸即時回讀角度；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of live read-back angles; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

zh: summary: 修改單顆舵機 ID（胸 cmd10，payload [舊id][新id]，掉電保持）
en: summary: Change one servo ID (chest cmd10, payload [oldId][newId], kept after a power cut)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 09 05 00 0a <id> <newId> 經胸板轉發 servo 碼 205 寫入舵機 EEPROM。單發唔重試（首發成功但 ACK 丟失時重試會用舊 ID 打空）。超時報 ok:false（已送出但無回覆，請用新 ID 試動驗證）。同一 bus 唔可以有兩粒同 ID
en: description: Sends f8 8f 09 05 00 0a <id> <newId>, the chest board forwards servo code 205 to write the servo EEPROM. A single send with no retry (retrying after the first send succeeded but the ACK was lost would hit the old ID for nothing). A timeout reports ok:false (sent but no reply, verify by moving with the new ID). Two servos on the same bus cannot share one ID

zh: description: 現時舵機 ID（舊）
en: description: Current servo ID (old)

zh: description: 目標舵機 ID（新，必須同舊唔同）
en: description: Target servo ID (new, must differ from the old)

zh: description: 結果（含 ack；超時請用新 ID 試動驗證）
en: description: Result (with ack; on a timeout verify by moving with the new ID)

zh: summary: 讀單顆舵機韌體版本（胸 cmd14 live query，純讀）
en: summary: Read one servo firmware version (chest cmd14 live query, read only)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 05 00 0e <id> 讀舵機韌體版本（胸板經 FC CF 轉發 servo 碼 1）。回覆格式未實測：version 係盡力解析（可 null），rawHex 先係準（請對 logcat RX 原幀核對）。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 05 00 0e <id> to read the servo firmware version (the chest board forwards servo code 1 via FC CF). The reply format is not field tested. version is a best-effort parse (may be null), rawHex is the one to trust (check it against the raw RX frame in logcat). A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false

zh: description: 舵機韌體版本（或讀失敗）
en: description: Servo firmware version (or a read failure)

zh: description: 版本欄原文 hex（格式未解，B0=0x53/0x30 分別對 8kg/20kg；可 null）
en: description: Version field raw hex (format not decoded, B0 = 0x53 or 0x30 for 8kg or 20kg; may be null)

zh: description: 舵機型號（B0 解：8kg/20kg；21/22 無回授故 null）
en: description: Servo model (decoded from B0, 8kg or 20kg; 21 and 22 have no feedback so null)

zh: description: 回覆 payload 原文 hex（以此為準）
en: description: Reply payload raw hex (this is the one to trust)

zh: summary: 一鍵讀全部 22 軸舵機韌體版本（cmd14，純讀）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of servo firmware version in one pass (cmd14, read only)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd14 實際讀取（每粒 500ms 單次，粒間隔 100ms；約十幾秒）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed。version 盡力解析，rawHex 先係準
en: description: Per servo cmd14 reads for real (500ms single shot per servo, 100ms apart; about ten or so seconds). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed. version is a best-effort parse, rawHex is the one to trust

zh: description: 22 軸韌體版本；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of firmware versions; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

zh: description: 每軸型號 8kg/20kg（B0 解；無回授軸 null）
en: description: Per-axis model 8kg or 20kg (decoded from B0; no-feedback axes are null)

zh: summary: 讀單顆舵機硬件資訊（胸 cmd33 live query，純讀）
en: summary: Read one servo hardware info (chest cmd33 live query, read only)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 05 00 21 <id> 讀舵機硬件資訊（servo 碼 18）。回覆格式未實測：hw 係盡力解析（可 null），rawHex 先係準。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 05 00 21 <id> to read the servo hardware info (servo code 18). The reply format is not field tested. hw is a best-effort parse (may be null), rawHex is the one to trust. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false

zh: description: 舵機硬件資訊（或讀失敗）
en: description: Servo hardware info (or a read failure)

zh: summary: 一鍵讀全部 22 軸舵機硬件資訊（cmd33，純讀）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of servo hardware info in one pass (cmd33, read only)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd33 實際讀取（每粒 500ms，粒間隔 100ms；失敗隔 300ms 再掃一次）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed
en: description: Per servo cmd33 reads for real (500ms per servo, 100ms apart; on a failure scan once more after 300ms). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed

zh: description: 22 軸硬件資訊；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of hardware info; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

zh: summary: 燒錄單顆舵機韌體（胸 cmd16/17，上行 134 回報；高危）
en: summary: Flash one servo firmware (chest cmd16/17, uplink 134 report; high risk)

zh: description: 流程 16 START([id][len BE32]，推斷格式）→ 17×112 頁（[id][01][seq][64B]）→ 等上行 134。硬閘：機上固件必須恰好 7168 bytes、電量 ≥50%、一次一粒。中途斷電／中止可能變磚；推斷格式若遭 chest 拒收則未燒錄直接失敗
en: description: Flow 16 START([id][len BE32], inferred format), then 17 times 112 pages ([id][01][seq][64B]), then wait for the uplink 134. Hard gates - the on-robot firmware must be exactly 7168 bytes, battery at least 50 percent, one servo at a time. A power cut or an abort in the middle may brick it. If the inferred format is refused by the chest, nothing flashes and it fails at once

zh: description: 目標舵機 ID（燒錄前請確認型號同固件匹配）
en: description: Target servo ID (before flashing, check the model matches the firmware)

zh: description: 已啟動（後續經 status 輪詢＋servo_upgrade_done 事件）
en: description: Started (then polled via status and the servo_upgrade_done event)

zh: summary: 查詢舵機韌體升級進度
en: summary: Query the servo firmware upgrade progress

zh: description: 進度 JSON（state/progress/page/total/id/fileExists/fileSizeBytes）
en: description: Progress JSON (state, progress, page, total, id, fileExists, fileSizeBytes)

zh: summary: 中止舵機韌體升級（只停後續頁，已寫入不回滾）
en: summary: Abort the servo firmware upgrade (stops only the following pages; written pages are not rolled back)

zh: summary: 設定聲納觸發距離閾值 (chest_configureSonar, cmd 4 sub 10)
en: summary: Set the sonar trigger distance threshold (chest_configureSonar, cmd 4 sub 10)

zh: description: cm (前端 slider 實測範圍 0-100)
en: description: cm (front end slider tested range 0-100)

zh: summary: 查詢聲納觸發距離閾值（0＝關；面板入頁同步開關用）
en: summary: Query the sonar trigger distance threshold (0 = off; used to sync the switch on the panel page)

zh: summary: 開關 PIR 人體感應器 (chest cmd 72)
en: summary: Toggle the PIR human sensor (chest cmd 72)

zh: summary: 開關 PIR 警示反應 (紅燈+鈴聲)
en: summary: Toggle the PIR warning response (red light and bell)

zh: description: 已設定
en: description: Set

zh: summary: 查詢 PIR 硬件開關＋警示反應開關（面板入頁同步用；硬件讀唔返，係自記態）
en: summary: Query the PIR hardware switch and warning response switch (used to sync the panel page; the hardware cannot be read back, it is a self-kept state)

zh: summary: 開關加速度計串流 (SensorManager)
en: summary: Toggle the accelerometer stream (SensorManager)

zh: summary: 查詢加速度計開關與可用性
en: summary: Query the accelerometer switch and availability

zh: summary: 設定頭部 5-mic LED (ledSetHead5Mic)
en: summary: Set the head 5-mic LED (ledSetHead5Mic)

zh: description: 1=紅 2=綠 3=藍 4=黃 5=紫 6=青 7=白
en: description: 1 red 2 green 3 blue 4 yellow 5 purple 6 cyan 7 white

zh: description: long=常亮 flash=閃 breathe=呼吸 chase=跑馬 dual=雙色 stop=熄
en: description: long = steady on, flash = blink, breathe = breathe, chase = chase, dual = two color, stop = off

zh: description: "效果速度 ms（唔帶=各 preset 經典值：flash 100 chase 100 dual 500 breathe 100；long/stop 無視）"
en: description: "Effect speed ms (absent = each preset classic value: flash 100 chase 100 dual 500 breathe 100; long/stop ignored)"

zh: description: "右邊 mask（唔帶=全開；逐粒試燈會帶而家著緊嗰半）"
en: description: "Right side mask (absent = all on; a per-lamp test carries the half that is on now)"

zh: description: "左邊 mask（唔帶=全開；逐粒試燈會帶而家著緊嗰半）"
en: description: "Left side mask (absent = all on; a per-lamp test carries the half that is on now)"

zh: summary: 設定眼部 5-mic LED (ledSetEye5Mic)
en: summary: Set the eye 5-mic LED (ledSetEye5Mic)

zh: description: 眼部無呼吸模式
en: description: The eye has no breathe mode

zh: description: "效果速度 ms（唔帶=各 preset 經典值：flash 100 chase 100 dual 500；long/stop 無視）"
en: description: "Effect speed ms (absent = each preset classic value: flash 100 chase 100 dual 500; long/stop ignored)"

zh: description: "左眼 mask（唔帶=全開；逐粒試燈會帶而家著緊嗰半）"
en: description: "Left eye mask (absent = all on; a per-lamp test carries the half that is on now)"

zh: description: "右眼 mask（唔帶=全開；逐粒試燈會帶而家著緊嗰半）"
en: description: "Right eye mask (absent = all on; a per-lamp test carries the half that is on now)"

zh: summary: 逐粒試燈 - 直接寫頭部 p3/p4 mask (長開)
en: summary: Per-lamp test - write the head p3/p4 mask directly (left on)

zh: description: "右邊 5 粒 mask (反序: 1號=16 2號=8 3號=4 4號=2 5號=1；第5粒係wifi位)"
en: description: "Right side 5-lamp mask (reverse order: 1st = 16, 2nd = 8, 3rd = 4, 4th = 2, 5th = 1; the 5th is the wifi slot)"

zh: description: "左邊 5 粒 mask (正序: 1號=1 2號=2 3號=4 4號=8 5號=16；第5粒係wifi位)"
en: description: "Left side 5-lamp mask (normal order: 1st = 1, 2nd = 2, 3rd = 4, 4th = 8, 5th = 16; the 5th is the wifi slot)"

zh: summary: 逐粒試燈 - 直接寫眼部 p3/p4 mask (長開)
en: summary: Per-lamp test - write the eye p3/p4 mask directly (left on)

zh: description: "左眼 8 粒 ring mask (順時針由12點起 1號=16 2號=8 3號=4 4號=2 5號=1 6號=128 7號=64 8號=32，全開=255)"
en: description: "Left eye 8-lamp ring mask (clockwise from 12 o'clock, 1st = 16, 2nd = 8, 3rd = 4, 4th = 2, 5th = 1, 6th = 128, 7th = 64, 8th = 32; all on = 255)"

zh: description: 右眼 8 粒 ring mask (同左眼)
en: description: Right eye 8-lamp ring mask (same as the left eye)

zh: summary: 逐粒試燈 mirror - 讀最後燈態 (硬件 write-only，server 記低最後一轉；未打過=-1，熄咗=0)
en: summary: Per-lamp test mirror - read the last lamp state (hardware write-only, the server keeps the last write; never written = -1, off = 0)

zh: description: 最後燈態 {head:{color,brightness,p3,p4},eye:{...},mouth:{runTime,breatheMs,offMs,playMs,mode},pad:{minus,plus},wifi,mute}（mute＝胸口燈有效態：小智連線 OR 播歌指示）
en: description: Last lamp state, head has color, brightness, p3, p4, eye has the same, mouth has runTime, breatheMs, offMs, playMs, mode, pad has minus and plus, plus wifi and mute (mute = the chest light effective state, the Xiaozhi connection OR a playing indicator)

zh: summary: 系統燈試燈 - wifi 燈紅/藍/熄 (下次 wifi 狀態變會自動校返正)
en: summary: System lamp test - wifi lamp red or blue or off (auto corrects itself on the next wifi state change)

zh: description: red=13 藍=12，off=全局熄（會連頭/眼一齊清，同系統行為一致）
en: description: red = 13, blue = 12, off = global off (clears the head and eye too, matching the system behavior)

zh: summary: 系統燈試燈 - 音量-/+ pad 燈 (14/16) 開熄 (on 唔帶=toggle)
en: summary: System lamp test - volume minus and plus pad lamp (14/16) on and off (on without a value = toggle)

zh: description: minus=14 (音量-) plus=16 (音量+)
en: description: minus = 14 (volume minus), plus = 16 (volume plus)

zh: description: 開/熄；唔帶=反轉而家狀態。熄=全局熄（頭/眼一齊熄，wifi 會補返；回傳當時 minus/plus 態）
en: description: On or off, absent = toggle the current state. Off = global off (head and eye off together, wifi refills; returns the minus and plus state at the time)

zh: description: 結果 {ok, minus, plus}
en: description: Result, ok, minus, plus

zh: summary: 系統燈試燈 - 胸口 mute 燈開熄 (純點燈，唔掂小智連線；連線/斷線/實體鍵會改寫)
en: summary: System lamp test - chest mute lamp on and off (pure lamp light, does not touch the Xiaozhi connection; connect, disconnect, or a physical key rewrites it)

zh: description: 開/熄 (chest cmd 68，連發三次防甩幀)
en: description: On or off (chest cmd 68, sent three times in a row to guard against dropped frames)

zh: summary: 設定嘴部 LED (LedControl JNI, 非 AIDL)
en: summary: Set the mouth LED (LedControl JNI, not AIDL)

zh: description: 呼吸速度 ms (100-1000)
en: description: Breathe speed ms (100-1000)

zh: description: 是否成功

en: // gamepad_bt, plus one poll here until the scan ends) → press Pair in the list → gamepad/pair → wait

en: // for the gamepad_bt bond event (visible in Event Log) → _done scans once more to confirm bonded.

en: // Bonded does not always mean connected. If the input list misses it, press Connect to link it. Pressing Connect while already linked is harmless.

zh: // 唔要嗰部機撳解除綁定（unpair）。
en: // Press Unpair to drop a device you do not want.

zh: // 5 秒後果（重查＋轉結果字）在 gamepadConnect 入面做，呢度淨係收錯。
en: // The 5-second result (re-check + result wording) runs inside gamepadConnect. This part only collects the error.

zh: // 解綁即時生效：4 秒後重掃＋刷新已接設備確認。
en: // Unpair takes effect at once: rescan + refresh the connected-device list after 4 s to confirm.

zh: // 配對要幾秒：6 秒後自動重掃確認（期間 bond 事件會入 Event Log）。
en: // Pairing takes a few seconds: auto rescan after 6 s to confirm. Bond events during the wait land in the Event Log.

zh: // 掃緊（約 12 秒窗）：8 秒後自動補一次，免手撳等漏咗後到的設備。
en: // During a scan (~12 s window): auto re-scan after 8 s so a late device is not missed.

zh: // 連接提示唔可以痴住唔走：5 秒後重查，轉做結果字。
en: // The connect hint must not stick: re-check after 5 s and replace it with the result wording.

zh: // 最後按鍵一行：key ↓/↑ → action [source] ✓/✗(只記錄)。
en: // Last-key row: key ↓/↑ → action [source] ✓/✗ (record only).

zh: // taken=false（機身直連鍵盤 HTML-only、放開事件、播失敗）即打✗，一眼分清
en: // taken=false (keyboard direct to HTML only, release events, play failure) shows ✗, so one look separates

zh: // 「有 action 名」同「真係做咗」係兩回事。
en: // "an action name exists" from "the action really ran".

zh: // 最後按鍵寫兩卡（手柄圖下＋鍵盤圖下同一行字）。
en: // Write the last key to both cards (the same row under the gamepad picture and the keyboard picture).
// ---------------- WS realtime: live last-key refresh ----------------

en: // When app-log.js appendLog() gets gamepad_key/gamepad_bt/gamepad_axis, it forwards them here.

zh: // 兩張圖＋映射行跟亮滅（色跟有無映射：WS 事件帶 action）。
en: // The two pictures + the mapping row light up together (colour follows the mapping: the WS event carries action).

zh: // 放開唔刷文字（後端 last 都唔記放開；呢度雙保險，免顯示閃去 ↑✗）。
en: // Release does not refresh the text (the backend last does not record releases either. This is a second guard so the display never flickers to ↑✗).

zh: // A 端搖桿經呢度郁點。

zh: // 映射 toggle 做咗，機身即推新態：掣即時跟（唔使入版重讀）。
en: // After a mapping toggle the robot pushes the new state, so the control follows at once (no need to reload the page).

zh: // bond／scan_done 落 Event Log 之餘，順手將管理卡現狀拉新一次。
en: // When bond/scan_done lands in the Event Log, refresh the management card state too.

en: // Mapping toggle writes the new state straight to the control (gamepad_state event. Same result as each page's enter-page sync, without waiting for them).

zh: // 動作清單緩存（機身 action/list 活數據優先，唔得先用內嵌 202 catalog）。
en: // Action-list cache (live action/list data first; fall back to the embedded 202 catalog).

zh: // 分組經 action_classification.json（靜態，同目錄 fetch）。
en: // Grouping comes from action_classification.json (static, fetched from the same directory).

zh: // id→動作對象（轉語言原地重標動作名用；填下拉嗰陣順手記）。
en: // id → action object (used to re-label action names in place on language switch; recorded while filling dropdowns).

zh: // 淨顯中／英文名，數字 id（14xxxxx／15xxxxx）唔顯示；存值照用 id，唔影響。
en: // Show only the Chinese/English name, not numeric ids (14xxxxx/15xxxxx). Stored values still use the id, so nothing changes.

zh: // 活數據到手：分類表照讀（靜態）。
en: // Live data arrived: the classification table still reads the static file.

zh: // 值拆解：none/stop 直回；music_*/vol_* 歸 music 種；
en: // Value parse: none/stop return directly; music_*/vol_* map to the music kind;

zh: // ring_phone/ring_stop/ring_random/ring:[phone:|notification:]<title> 歸 ring 種；head:/eye: 歸 led 種；
en: // ring_phone/ring_stop/ring_random/ring:[phone:|notification:]<title> map to the ring kind; head:/eye: map to the led kind;

zh: // servo<N>± 拆轴向；action:<id> 拆 id。
en: // servo<N>± splits the axis; action:<id> splits the id.

zh: // 建舵機單一下拉（#1+／#1-／#2+…#22- 共 44 格；id 按邊分名前綴，兩區同名鍵唔撞）。
en: // Build the servo single dropdown (#1+/#1-/#2+...#22-, 44 entries. The id prefixes the side's group name, so same-named keys in the two zones never clash).

zh: // 動作所屬大類（同 action tab 同一規則：按動作本身 type 分；緩存未到先用分類表 sub 頂住）。
en: // Action class lookup (same rule as the action tab: use the action's own type; before the cache arrives, use the classification sub as a stopgap).

zh: // 建 202 動作級聯下拉（先大類、再入面動作；數據未到先得提示，load 完補）。
en: // Build the 202-action cascading dropdown (class first, then actions inside it. Before data arrives, show the hint only; fill after load).

zh: // 填某行個動作下拉（cat 空即按現值自動判定大類；curId 唔喺類入面即補 (?) 粒）。
en: // Fill one row's action dropdown (empty cat: derive the class from the current value. A curId missing from the class gets a (?) entry).

zh: // element 版（build 嗰陣未入 DOM，唔用 getElementById）。
en: // Element version (not in the DOM yet during build, so no getElementById).

zh: // dataset.actionFilled＝用有數據嗰次填過（late-fill 唔好數 options：miss 粒都計數）。
en: // dataset.actionFilled marks a fill done with real data (late-fill must not count options: missing entries also count).

zh: // 現值唔喺清單（刪咗的動作）：補一粒等用家睇到。
en: // Current value not in the list (deleted action): add an entry so the user still sees it.

zh: // 鈴聲名緩存（分電話／通知兩表；audio/ringtones/list 活數據，同 action 清單一樣懶載）。
en: // Ringtone-name cache (phone/notification tables; live audio/ringtones/list data, lazy-loaded like the action list).

zh: // 值裡抽鈴聲表名（唔係鈴聲即回 phone；舊式 ring: 歸 phone 表搵名）。
en: // Pull the ringtone table name from a value (a non-ringtone value returns phone; old-style ring: looks its name up in the phone table).

zh: // 值裡抽裸 title（fixed 三粒回 ""；舊式去 ring: 頭）。
en: // Pull the bare title from a value (the three fixed entries return ""; old style strips the ring: prefix).

zh: // 建鈴聲兩下拉（系統預設電話鈴＋鈴聲停＋隨機＋電話／通知表；名單後到即補）。
en: // Build the two ringtone dropdowns (system default phone ring + ring stop + random + phone/notification tables; the name list arrives later and fills in).

zh: // 同名優先跟過去新表（兩表撞名常見；fixed 三粒名唔會撞 title）。
en: // For duplicate names the match follows the newer table (clashes between the two tables are common; the three fixed names never clash with a title).

zh: // 重填先清舊名單（fixed 三粒無冒號，保留；miss／舊值有冒號，一併清再補）。
en: // Before a refill, clear old list entries (the three fixed entries have no colon and stay; missing/old values have colons, so clear them all and re-add).

zh: // 名單未到：現值係鈴聲即補一粒等睇到（同 action 那個做法）。
en: // Name list not arrived: if the current value is a ringtone, add an entry so it stays visible (same as the action case).

zh: // 舊式 ring: 值但個名喺表入面（僅缺前綴）：唔打 (?)，照播到。
en: // Old-style ring: value whose name is in the table (only the prefix is missing): no (?), it still plays.

zh: // 建 LED 三下拉（部位＋效果＋色；效果跟部位變，dual 換 3 對色單，色名跟語言）。
en: // Build the three LED dropdowns (part + effect + colour. Effects change with the part; dual swaps in the 3-pair colour list; colour names follow the language).

zh: // LED 色下拉（dual 照 LED tab 同一套：3=藍綠／4=紅綠／5=紅藍，其他 code 出嚟都係藍綠
en: // LED colour dropdown (dual uses the LED tab's set: 3=blue-green, 4=red-green, 5=red-blue. Other codes

zh: // 唔擺出嚟，見 app-led.js DUAL_COLORS；現值唔啱位即歸第一粒）。
en: // also come out blue-green, so they are not offered. See DUAL_COLORS in app-led.js; a wrong current value falls back to the first entry).

zh: // 咀速（breathing 先用，100-1000ms，後端同驗）。
en: // Mouth speed (used only with breathing, 100-1000 ms. The backend validates it too).

zh: // dual 換 3 對色單，其餘換返 7 色（現值保留，唔啱位先歸一）。
en: // dual switches to the 3-pair list, the rest switch back to 7 colours (keep the current value; only a wrong one falls back to the first).

zh: // 頭眼 stop／random 唔使色；咀 breathing 先使速，off 乜都唔使。
en: // Head/eye stop/random need no colour; the mouth needs a speed only for breathing; off needs nothing.

zh: // 映射表顯隱：跟各自卡內映射開關（預設閂，記 localStorage；開左先 show）。
en: // Mapping-table visibility: follows the mapping switch inside each card (default closed, saved in localStorage; shown only when opened).

zh: // 同執行開關（A 端直連掣）係兩回事。
en: // This is separate from the execution switch (the A-side direct-connect button).

zh: // 動作清單／鈴聲名單後到：先畫骨架（下拉空），load 完再填兩區下拉。
en: // Action list/ringtone list arrive late: draw the skeleton first (empty dropdowns), then fill both zones after load.

zh: // 未用有數據填過即補（唔數 options：miss 粒都會令數目超標）。
en: // Fill when a real-data fill has not happened yet (do not count options: missing entries also inflate the count).

zh: // 表啱＋用有數據填過即跳過；表唔啱／未用數據填過即補。
en: // Skip when the table matches and a real-data fill happened; refill when the table mismatches or no data fill happened yet.

zh: // 包單部部機唔同，每次 render 重抓（唔用舊緩存）；淨係填得提示一粒嗰啲。
en: // Package lists differ per robot, so re-fetch every render (no stale cache); refill only rows holding just the hint entry.

zh: // 收藏成日加減，每次 render 重抓；淨係填得開關一粒嗰啲（有多粒即已有嘢／用家啱揀緊）。
en: // Favourites change often, so re-fetch every render; refill only dropdowns holding just the switch entry (more entries mean data exists or the user is picking).

zh: // 顯隱：恒顯示。
en: // Visibility: always shown.

zh: // 轉語言即時重標映射表（原地改字：未存改動保留，唔 rebuild，唔問後端）。
en: // On language switch, re-label the mapping table in place (unsaved edits survive; no rebuild, no backend call).

zh: // 鍵名／servo #N±／鈴聲名／(?) 項係語言無關，唔郁。
en: // Key names, servo #N±, ringtone names and (?) entries are language-independent and stay untouched.

zh: // 存值 eq:<preset>：名跟音樂頁同一組。
en: // Stored value eq:<preset> (names come from the same set as the music page).

zh: // 小智／Vosk 組名跟語言。
en: // The "小智"/Vosk group names follow the language.

zh: // 提示跟語言；包名就地用緩存重算（(?) 刪檔項唔郁）。
en: // The hint follows the language; package names recompute in place from the cache ((?) deleted-file entries stay untouched).

zh: // 3 粒即 dual 三對，7 粒即普通七色。
en: // 3 entries mean the dual three pairs; 7 entries mean the normal seven colours.

zh: // gpServo_（#N±）唔使理。
en: // Ignore gpServo_ (#N±).

zh: // 等化器入口（揀咗先行隔籬 eq 下拉；存值 eq:<preset>）。
en: // Equaliser entry (shown only after the neighbouring eq dropdown is picked; stored value eq:<preset>).

zh: // EQ presets（同音樂頁同一組名；存值 eq:<preset>）。
en: // EQ presets (same names as the music page; stored value eq:<preset>).

zh: // Vosk 語言包緩存（vosk/models 活數據：已裝包；同鈴聲名單一樣懶載）。
en: // Vosk language-pack cache (live vosk/models data: installed packs; lazy-loaded like the ringtone list).

zh: // 建語音兩下拉（小智／Vosk 組＋該組語言包；包單後到即補；vosk_toggle 舊值歸 Vosk 組）。
en: // Build the two voice dropdowns ("小智"/Vosk group + that group's language packs; the pack list arrives later and fills in; old vosk_toggle values map to the Vosk group).

zh: // build 嗰陣未入 DOM，直接設（入 DOM 後轉組經上面 onchange＋sync）。
en: // Not in the DOM yet during build, so set it directly (after entering the DOM, group changes go through the onchange + sync above).

zh: // Vosk 組先出包單（小智組收起）。
en: // Only the Vosk group shows the pack list (the "小智" group keeps it collapsed).

zh: // 等化器下拉：music 種揀咗等化器入口先出，其他值一律收起。
en: // Equaliser dropdown: appears only when the music kind selects the equaliser entry; every other value hides it.

zh: // fixed 兩粒重標用（值→i18n key；語言包名就地用緩存重算）。
en: // For re-labelling the two fixed entries (value → i18n key; language-pack names recompute in place from the cache).

zh: // 填包單（提示＋已裝包；舊值唔喺度即補 (?)；無包即得提示）。
en: // Fill the pack list (hint + installed packs; an old value missing from the list gets a (?) entry; with no packs, keep only the hint).

zh: // 讀某行現時值（同舊逐行存同一拼法；action 未揀回 null 即成行跳過）。
en: // Read one row's current value (same assembly as the old per-row save; action not picked returns null and the whole row is skipped).

zh: // 等化器入口：取值隔籬 eq 下拉。
en: // Equaliser entry: take the value from the neighbouring eq dropdown.

zh: // 收藏都無即空單：回 null 成行跳過，唔亂存。
en: // Empty list when even the favourites miss it: return null and skip the row instead of storing a wrong value.

zh: // 成區一次過存：只送同緩存唔同的行，一個掣搞掂（取代逐行存）。
en: // Save a whole zone at once: send only rows that differ from the cache, with one button (replaces per-row saves).

zh: // （B 端 Gamepad API 輪詢／開關已移除：本頁只做 A 端顯示＋映射。

zh: summary: 控制單顆舵機角度（cmd05 單發；可選連 trim 經 cmd12 寫入 chest EEPROM）
en: summary: Control one servo angle (cmd05 single send; optional trim write to chest EEPROM via cmd12)

zh: description: 只動目標一粒。trim 有帶就接著寫入（掉電保持，亂寫會改出廠校準；掃描驗證）。17/18 號手指天生無回授，trim 寫入會報失敗
en: description: Moves only the target one. If a trim is carried it is written after (kept after a power cut, a wrong write changes the factory calibration; scan to verify). Servos 17 and 18 (fingers) have no feedback by nature, so a trim write reports failure

zh: description: 偏差值（signed），經 cmd12 寫入 chest EEPROM 並掉電保持；不帶就僅動角度
en: description: Offset value (signed), written to chest EEPROM via cmd12 and kept after a power cut; absent = move the angle only

zh: description: 結果（含 trim 寫入狀態）
en: description: Result (with the trim write state)

zh: description: true = 已送出但回覆被搶食（未知寫入否，重新掃描驗證；實測零 ACK 照存入）
en: description: true = sent but the reply was eaten (write success unknown, rescan to verify; in testing zero ACK still stores it)

zh: summary: 同時控制全部舵機（20 或 22 顆）
en: summary: Control all servos at once (20 or 22)

zh: description: 20（舵機 1-20）或 22（舵機 1-22）個逗號分隔角度；20 相容舊客戶端只動 1-20，22 前 20 走 cmd3、21/22 各補一發 cmd05
en: description: 20 (servos 1-20) or 22 (servos 1-22) comma-separated angles; 20 is for old clients and moves only 1-20, 22 uses cmd3 for the first 20 and adds one cmd05 each for 21 and 22

zh: summary: 實際讀取單顆舵機 trim（胸 cmd13 live query，官方 tuner 同款）
en: summary: Read one servo trim for real (chest cmd13 live query, same as the official tuner)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 05 00 0d <id> 讀 chest 存住的偏差原值（官方角:偏 = 1:3），不是絕對角度；8 號例：位姿 65 下橫跨多次讀數恒為 -33。讀不到（超時／舵機回 01 error，如本機 5/6 號硬件壞；17/18 號手指天生無回授）報 ok:false。commanded 是命令位姿追踪值，僅供參考
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 05 00 0d <id> to read the offset value the chest stores (official angle to offset is 1 to 3), not the absolute angle; example servo 8, at pose 65, reads -33 across many reads. A read failure (timeout, or the servo answers 01 error, such as hardware-bad 5 and 6 on this unit; fingers 17 and 18 have no feedback by nature) reports ok:false. commanded is the commanded-pose track value, for reference only

zh: description: trim 實際讀取值（或讀失敗）
en: description: Trim value read for real (or a read failure)

zh: description: chest 存住的偏差原值 signed（成功先有）
en: description: The offset value the chest stores (signed; present on success)

zh: description: 命令位姿追踪值（可 null），僅供參考
en: description: Commanded-pose track value (may be null), for reference only

zh: summary: 逐顆實際讀取全部 22 軸 trim（tuner 掃描 offset 用，官方節奏約十幾 ms 一粒）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of trim for real, one by one (for the tuner offset scan; the official pace is about ten or so ms per servo)

zh: description: 22 軸 trim 原值；讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed
en: description: 22 axes of trim values; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed

zh: summary: 實際讀取單顆舵機絕對角度（胸 cmd6 live query）
en: summary: Read one servo absolute angle for real (chest cmd6 live query)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 00 00 06 <id> 讀即時角度（同 servo/one 同單位；跟位實測誤差約 1°）。注意不是 servo/read 那個 trim/偏差。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 00 00 06 <id> to read the live angle (same unit as servo/one; a follow-up test shows an error of about 1 degree). Note this is not the trim or offset of servo/read. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false

zh: description: 絕對角度實際讀取值（或讀失敗）
en: description: Absolute angle value read for real (or a read failure)

zh: description: 即時絕對角度（成功先有）
en: description: Live absolute angle (present on success)

zh: summary: 讀單顆舵機絕對角度並即寫回上力（原子操作）
en: summary: Read one servo absolute angle and write it back with torque at once (one atomic step)

zh: description: 先 cmd6 實際讀取（會鬆開那顆），即用 servo/one（cmd05）寫回同一個位上力，全程後端內完成。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false 且不寫回
en: description: First cmd6 reads for real (this releases that servo), then servo/one (cmd05) writes back the same position with torque, all inside the backend. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false and does not write back

zh: description: 絕對角度＋有無寫回上力（或讀失敗）
en: description: Absolute angle, and whether torque was written back (or a read failure)

zh: description: 有無即寫回上力（成功先有）
en: description: Whether torque was written back at once (present on success)

zh: summary: 連讀 22 軸絕對角度，每粒即寫回上力（100ms 間隔）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of absolute angle in a row, writing each back with torque (100ms apart)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd6 實際讀取＋即 servo/one 寫回同位（讀會鬆開那顆，寫回即上力；單粒已證實無鬆無動，22 連讀實測中）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed，且不寫回
en: description: Per servo cmd6 reads for real, plus servo/one writes back the same position (a read releases that servo, writing back sets torque; one servo is confirmed no-release no-move, the 22 in a row is under test). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed, and not written back

zh: description: 22 軸即時角度＋逐顆有無寫回；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of live angles, and per servo whether written back; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

zh: description: 恆 true（即時讀數）
en: description: Always true (a live reading)

zh: description: 逐顆有無即寫回上力
en: description: Per servo whether torque was written back at once

zh: summary: 實際讀取單顆舵機回讀角度（胸 cmd23/0x17 live query，PC 工具「讀角度 6」同款）
en: summary: Read one servo read-back angle for real (chest cmd23/0x17 live query, same as the PC tool read angle 6)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 00 00 17 <id> 讀即時角度（同 servo/one 同單位；跟 0x06 同級，未驗證誤差）。注意不是 servo/read 那個 trim/偏差。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false。0x17 會唔會鬆舵機未知——呢個 endpoint 純讀唔寫回，實測中
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 00 00 17 <id> to read the live angle (same unit as servo/one; same class as 0x06, error not verified). Note this is not the trim or offset of servo/read. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false. Whether 0x17 releases the servo is unknown - this endpoint is read only and writes back nothing, under test

zh: description: 回讀角度實際讀取值（或讀失敗）
en: description: Read-back angle value read for real (or a read failure)

zh: description: 即時回讀角度（成功先有）
en: description: Live read-back angle (present on success)

zh: summary: 連讀 22 軸回讀角度（cmd23/0x17，無間隔，純讀唔寫回）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of read-back angle in a row (cmd23/0x17, no interval, read only and no write back)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd23 實際讀取，一次過 22 粒（無間隔、唔重試、不寫回；實測 20 粒 230ms 全中，21/22 真機證實有回授）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed
en: description: Per servo cmd23 reads for real, all 22 in one pass (no interval, no retry, no write back; in testing all 20 hit in 230ms, 21 and 22 confirmed to have feedback on a real unit). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed

zh: description: 22 軸即時回讀角度；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of live read-back angles; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

zh: summary: 修改單顆舵機 ID（胸 cmd10，payload [舊id][新id]，掉電保持）
en: summary: Change one servo ID (chest cmd10, payload [oldId][newId], kept after a power cut)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 09 05 00 0a <id> <newId> 經胸板轉發 servo 碼 205 寫入舵機 EEPROM。單發唔重試（首發成功但 ACK 丟失時重試會用舊 ID 打空）。超時報 ok:false（已送出但無回覆，請用新 ID 試動驗證）。同一 bus 唔可以有兩粒同 ID
en: description: Sends f8 8f 09 05 00 0a <id> <newId>, the chest board forwards servo code 205 to write the servo EEPROM. A single send with no retry (retrying after the first send succeeded but the ACK was lost would hit the old ID for nothing). A timeout reports ok:false (sent but no reply, verify by moving with the new ID). Two servos on the same bus cannot share one ID

zh: description: 現時舵機 ID（舊）
en: description: Current servo ID (old)

zh: description: 目標舵機 ID（新，必須同舊唔同）
en: description: Target servo ID (new, must differ from the old)

zh: description: 結果（含 ack；超時請用新 ID 試動驗證）
en: description: Result (with ack; on a timeout verify by moving with the new ID)

zh: summary: 讀單顆舵機韌體版本（胸 cmd14 live query，純讀）
en: summary: Read one servo firmware version (chest cmd14 live query, read only)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 05 00 0e <id> 讀舵機韌體版本（胸板經 FC CF 轉發 servo 碼 1）。回覆格式未實測：version 係盡力解析（可 null），rawHex 先係準（請對 logcat RX 原幀核對）。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 05 00 0e <id> to read the servo firmware version (the chest board forwards servo code 1 via FC CF). The reply format is not field tested. version is a best-effort parse (may be null), rawHex is the one to trust (check it against the raw RX frame in logcat). A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false

zh: description: 舵機韌體版本（或讀失敗）
en: description: Servo firmware version (or a read failure)

zh: description: 版本欄原文 hex（格式未解，B0=0x53/0x30 分別對 8kg/20kg；可 null）
en: description: Version field raw hex (format not decoded, B0 = 0x53 or 0x30 for 8kg or 20kg; may be null)

zh: description: 舵機型號（B0 解：8kg/20kg；21/22 無回授故 null）
en: description: Servo model (decoded from B0, 8kg or 20kg; 21 and 22 have no feedback so null)

zh: description: 回覆 payload 原文 hex（以此為準）
en: description: Reply payload raw hex (this is the one to trust)

zh: summary: 一鍵讀全部 22 軸舵機韌體版本（cmd14，純讀）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of servo firmware version in one pass (cmd14, read only)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd14 實際讀取（每粒 500ms 單次，粒間隔 100ms；約十幾秒）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed。version 盡力解析，rawHex 先係準
en: description: Per servo cmd14 reads for real (500ms single shot per servo, 100ms apart; about ten or so seconds). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed. version is a best-effort parse, rawHex is the one to trust

zh: description: 22 軸韌體版本；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of firmware versions; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

zh: description: 每軸型號 8kg/20kg（B0 解；無回授軸 null）
en: description: Per-axis model 8kg or 20kg (decoded from B0; no-feedback axes are null)

zh: summary: 讀單顆舵機硬件資訊（胸 cmd33 live query，純讀）
en: summary: Read one servo hardware info (chest cmd33 live query, read only)

zh: description: 發 f8 8f 08 05 00 21 <id> 讀舵機硬件資訊（servo 碼 18）。回覆格式未實測：hw 係盡力解析（可 null），rawHex 先係準。讀不到（超時）報 ok:false
en: description: Sends f8 8f 08 05 00 21 <id> to read the servo hardware info (servo code 18). The reply format is not field tested. hw is a best-effort parse (may be null), rawHex is the one to trust. A read failure (timeout) reports ok:false

zh: description: 舵機硬件資訊（或讀失敗）
en: description: Servo hardware info (or a read failure)

zh: summary: 一鍵讀全部 22 軸舵機硬件資訊（cmd33，純讀）
en: summary: Read all 22 axes of servo hardware info in one pass (cmd33, read only)

zh: description: 逐顆 cmd33 實際讀取（每粒 500ms，粒間隔 100ms；失敗隔 300ms 再掃一次）。讀不到那顆記 null 並列入 failed
en: description: Per servo cmd33 reads for real (500ms per servo, 100ms apart; on a failure scan once more after 300ms). A servo that cannot be read is recorded as null and listed in failed

zh: description: 22 軸硬件資訊；讀不到那顆記 null
en: description: 22 axes of hardware info; a servo that cannot be read is recorded as null

en: summary: Flash one servo firmware (chest cmd16/17, uplink 134 report; high risk)

zh: description: 流程 16 START([id][len BE32]，推斷格式）→ 17×112 頁（[id][01][seq][64B]）→ 等上行 134。硬閘：機上固件必須恰好 7168 bytes、電量 ≥50%、一次一粒。中途斷電／中止可能變磚；推斷格式若遭 chest 拒收則未燒錄直接失敗
en: description: Flow 16 START([id][len BE32], inferred format), then 17 times 112 pages ([id][01][seq][64B]), then wait for the uplink 134. Hard gates - the on-robot firmware must be exactly 7168 bytes, battery at least 50 percent, one servo at a time. A power cut or an abort in the middle may brick it. If the inferred format is refused by the chest, nothing flashes and it fails at once

zh: description: 目標舵機 ID（燒錄前請確認型號同固件匹配）
en: description: Target servo ID (before flashing, check the model matches the firmware)

en: description: cm (front end slider tested range 0-100)

zh: description: '完整 wire frame hex. On port=chest, frames with cmd 0x19 [00] or cmd 0x40 [01 ..] start the "Sit down" move (alpha2-brain#24) and need allow_sit_down=true, else 400. On port=chest the hex must also be whole frames only (correct length, checksum and tail, no extra bytes), else 400 (alpha2-brain#25). A frame split over two calls is refused. With allow_sit_down=true, the app skips both refusals on port=chest: the sit-down refusal and the whole-frame refusal, so a split frame then goes through.'
en: description: 'Full wire frame hex. On port=chest, frames with cmd 0x19 [00] or cmd 0x40 [01 ..] start the "Sit down" move (alpha2-brain#24) and need allow_sit_down=true, else 400. On port=chest the hex must also be whole frames only (correct length, checksum and tail, no extra bytes), else 400 (alpha2-brain#25). A frame split over two calls is refused. With allow_sit_down=true, the app skips both refusals on port=chest: the sit-down refusal and the whole-frame refusal, so a split frame then goes through.'

zh: description: 純 framework android.media.FaceDetector，零額外依賴、離線可用。會自動開相機（若未開流），按 intervalMs 抽樣檢測，死區＋步進驅動頭部 yaw/pitch。播動作時請先停追蹤，兩邊同搶頭部舵機會打架。
en: description: Pure framework android.media.FaceDetector, zero extra dependency, usable offline. It opens the camera if the stream is not open, samples detection every intervalMs, and a dead zone plus a step drive the head yaw and pitch. Stop the tracking before playing an action, or both fight over the head servos

zh: description: 檢測間隔 ms（預設 500；無臉／全圖搜用呢個；自動開且跟到臉改用 trackIntervalMs）
en: description: Detection interval ms (default 500; used with no face or a full-image search; a face found with auto open switches to trackIntervalMs)

en: description: Detection interval ms when a face is found (default 100; only when auto open; a single-frame ROI is about 25ms, a full image 320x240 is about 80ms in testing)

zh: description: 自動間隔（預設 true；開＝無臉慢掃、跟到快掃；關＝一律用 intervalMs）
en: description: Auto interval (default true; on = slow scan with no face, fast scan when a face is found; off = always use intervalMs)

zh: description: 每次最大跟隨步進（度，預設 17；死區外按偏移比例折算）

zh: description: 中央死區（歸一化半寬，預設 0.10；臉在死區內不動頭）
en: description: Center dead zone (normalized half-width, default 0.10; a face inside the dead zone does not move the head)

zh: description: 單步舵機執行時間 ms（預設 400）
en: description: Single-step servo run time ms (default 400)

zh: description: FaceDetector 最大人臉數（預設 3；只跟最大一張）
en: description: FaceDetector max face count (default 3; it follows only the largest one)

zh: description: 追頭總開關（預設 true；關＝只偵測＋畫框，頭不動）
en: description: Follow-head master switch (default true; off = detect and draw the box only, the head does not move)

en: description: ROI follow (default true; after a detection it scans only near the face, 320x240 at 10fps held; after 3 misses it returns to a full-image scan)

en: description: Tracking state (same shape as face/track/status)

en: summary: Stop the face tracking (the head holds its position, it does not auto return to center)

zh: description: 追蹤狀態
en: description: Tracking state

zh: summary: 開始純 Java 顏色追蹤（HSV 閾值＋最大 blob＋頭部 19/20 跟色）
en: summary: Start pure Java color tracking (HSV threshold + largest blob + head 19/20 follow the color)

zh: description: 零額外依賴（唔用 TFLite／OpenCV／ML Kit），離線可用。會自動開相機（若未開流），160x120 逐像素 HSV 閾值取最大色塊質心，死區＋步進驅動頭部 yaw/pitch。預設跟紅色（hue 335-25°）。同人臉追蹤互斥：啟動即停另一邊。播動作時請先停追蹤，兩邊同搶頭部舵機會打架。
en: description: Zero extra dependency (no TFLite, OpenCV, or ML Kit), usable offline. It opens the camera if the stream is not open, thresholds each pixel at 160x120 to take the largest color blob center, and a dead zone plus a step drive the head yaw and pitch. It follows red by default (hue 335-25). It is exclusive with face tracking, starting it stops the other. Stop the tracking before playing an action, or both fight over the head servos

zh: description: 檢測間隔 ms（預設 200；掃唔到用呢個；自動開且跟到色改用 trackIntervalMs）

zh: description: 中央死區（歸一化半寬，預設 0.10；色塊質心在死區內不動頭）
en: description: Center dead zone (normalized half-width, default 0.10; a blob center inside the dead zone does not move the head)

zh: description: 目標色 hue 下限（度，預設 335；hMin>hMax 即 wrap 過 0°，如紅色 335-25）

en: description: Target color hue upper bound (degrees, default 25)

zh: description: 明度下限（預設 0.25；去暗背影）
en: description: Brightness lower bound (default 0.25; drops a dark background)

zh: description: 明度上限（預設 1.0；調低可去白光反光）

en: description: Walk-follow master switch (default false; on = play a turn when off to the side, a step forward when far, stand still when near; it plays only the built-in short gait, one action at a time, and does not send a new step when nothing is found or on stop. Open it on flat ground, cleared, with someone watching)

zh: description: "`com.open.alpha2` 裝在 UBTECH Alpha2 機械人 (Android 5.1.1, API 22) 上的本地控制面板 HTTP + WebSocket API。 依 `MainActivity handleApi()` / `HttpServer` 反向生成， 覆蓋機械人全部本機能力（原 17 個 AIDL interface 功能，現經直驅實現），加上獨立的 system/xiaozhi/stream/upload 命名空間。 預設由 `HttpServer.PORT = 8888` 以純 HTTP 提供 (`http://:8888/`)，同 WiFi 任何瀏覽器可直接訪問。 所有 `/api/*` 回應皆為 `application/json; charset=utf-8` 的 `{ok: boolean, ...}` 形狀，失敗時帶 `error` 欄位。401 一律附 `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="panel"`。 即時事件 (觸摸/ASR/電池/跌落/PIR 等) 經 `GET /ws` (RFC6455 WebSocket) 推送，非輪詢。 實驗 tab 另有 opt-in 面板 token (`/api/system/auth/*`，見 PanelAuth.java)：預設關閉（全開）； 啟用後成個面板上鎖——全部 `/api/*`（含讀操作、其他分頁、Blockly）、全部 `/upload/*`、 `/stream/*` 同 `/ws` 要帶認證（`Authorization: Bearer ` 主；設不到 header 的 ``／WebSocket 用 `?panel_token=` fallback），缺／錯回 401；淨 `system/auth/*` （解鎖入口）同靜態頁開放。Token 記喺瀏覽器 localStorage（同一個面板地址跨 tab 共用）。 舊 `?token=` 別名已移除（同小智 ota `token` 撞名），curl 請用 `-H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` 或 `?panel_token=`。 ",
en: description: "The local control panel of `com.open.alpha2` on the UBTECH Alpha 2 robot (Android 5.1.1, API 22), the HTTP + WebSocket API. Generated from `MainActivity handleApi()` / `HttpServer`, it covers all local robot capabilities (the original 17 AIDL interface functions, now by direct drive), plus the separate system/xiaozhi/stream/upload namespaces. By default it is served as plain HTTP on `HttpServer.PORT = 8888` (`http://:8888/`), reachable by any browser on the same WiFi. All `/api/*` answers are `application/json; charset=utf-8` of the `{ok: boolean, ...}` shape, with an `error` field on failure. A 401 always carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="panel"`. Live events (touch/ASR/battery/fall/PIR and more) are pushed over `GET /ws` (RFC6455 WebSocket), not polled. The experiment tab has an opt-in panel token (`/api/system/auth/*`, see PanelAuth.java): off by default (fully open); when enabled the whole panel is locked — all `/api/*` (read calls, other pages, Blockly included), all `/upload/*`, `/stream/*` and `/ws` need authentication (`Authorization: Bearer ` first; where a header is not possible, `/WebSocket use the `?panel_token=` fallback), a missing or wrong token returns 401; only `system/auth/*` (the unlock entry) and the static pages stay open. The token is kept in browser localStorage (shared across tabs of the same panel address). The old `?token=` alias is removed (name clash with the Xiaozhi ota `token`), use `-H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` with curl or `?panel_token=`. ",

A timeout reports ok:false (sent but no reply, verify by moving with the new ID). Two servos on the same bus cannot share one ID

zh: description: '完整 wire frame hex. On port=chest, frames with cmd 0x19 [00] or cmd 0x40 [01 ..] start the "Sit down" move (alpha2-brain#24) and need allow_sit_down=true, else 400. On port=chest the hex must also be whole frames only (correct length, checksum and tail, no extra bytes), else 400 (alpha2-brain#25). A frame split over two calls is refused. en: description: 'Full wire frame hex. On port=chest, frames with cmd 0x19 [00] or cmd 0x40 [01 ..] start the "Sit down" move (alpha2-brain#24) and need allow_sit_down=true, else 400. zh: summary: 開始 Android 內置人臉追蹤（FaceDetector＋頭部 19/20 跟人）
en: summary: Start the built-in Android face tracking (FaceDetector + head 19/20 follow)

zh: description: 純 framework android.media.FaceDetector，零額外依賴、離線可用。會自動開相機（若未開流），按 intervalMs 抽樣檢測，死區＋步進驅動頭部 yaw/pitch。播動作時請先停追蹤，兩邊同搶頭部舵機會打架。
en: description: Pure framework android.media.FaceDetector, zero extra dependency, usable offline. It opens the camera if the stream is not open, samples detection every intervalMs, and a dead zone plus a step drive the head yaw and pitch. Stop the tracking before playing an action, or both fight over the head servos

zh: description: 檢測間隔 ms（預設 500；無臉／全圖搜用呢個；自動開且跟到臉改用 trackIntervalMs）
en: description: Detection interval ms (default 500; used with no face or a full-image search; a face found with auto open switches to trackIntervalMs)

zh: description: 跟到臉時檢測間隔 ms（預設 100；僅自動開有效；實測單幀 ROI ~25ms、全圖 320x240 ~80ms）
en: description: Detection interval ms when a face is found (default 100; only when auto open; a single-frame ROI is about 25ms, a full image 320x240 is about 80ms in testing)

zh: description: 自動間隔（預設 true；開＝無臉慢掃、跟到快掃；關＝一律用 intervalMs）
en: description: Auto interval (default true; on = slow scan with no face, fast scan when a face is found; off = always use intervalMs)

zh: description: 每次最大跟隨步進（度，預設 17；死區外按偏移比例折算）
en: description: Max follow step per move (degrees, default 17; outside the dead zone it scales by the offset)

zh: description: 中央死區（歸一化半寬，預設 0.10；臉在死區內不動頭）
en: description: Center dead zone (normalized half-width, default 0.10; a face inside the dead zone does not move the head)

zh: description: 單步舵機執行時間 ms（預設 400）
en: description: Single-step servo run time ms (default 400)

zh: description: FaceDetector 最大人臉數（預設 3；只跟最大一張）
en: description: FaceDetector max face count (default 3; it follows only the largest one)

zh: description: 追頭總開關（預設 true；關＝只偵測＋畫框，頭不動）
en: description: Follow-head master switch (default true; off = detect and draw the box only, the head does not move)

zh: description: ROI 跟隨（預設 true；檢到後只掃臉附近，320x240 長開 10fps 用；掃唔到 3 次回全圖）
en: description: ROI follow (default true; after a detection it scans only near the face, 320x240 at 10fps held; after 3 misses it returns to a full-image scan)

zh: description: 追蹤狀態（同 face/track/status 同形狀）
en: description: Tracking state (same shape as face/track/status)

zh: summary: 停止人臉追蹤（頭停在現位，不自動回中）
en: summary: Stop the face tracking (the head holds its position, it does not auto return to center)

zh: description: 追蹤狀態
en: description: Tracking state

zh: summary: 查詢人臉追蹤狀態（running／人臉框／頭角度／統計）
en: summary: Query the face tracking state (running, face box, head angles, stats)

zh: summary: 更新人臉追蹤參數（不啟停；啟動中亦可即時調）
en: summary: Update the face tracking parameters (no start or stop; they can be tuned live while running)

zh: summary: 人臉偵測能力探測（硬件 HAL vs 軟件 FaceDetector）
en: summary: Face detection capability probe (hardware HAL vs software FaceDetector)

zh: description: 只讀參數，不開追蹤迴圈。hardwareMaxFaces>0 代表可用零 CPU 全速硬件路；softwareAvailable 代表現行軟件路可用。
en: description: Parameters only, it does not start the tracking loop. hardwareMaxFaces greater than 0 means the zero-CPU full-speed hardware path is usable. softwareAvailable means the current software path is usable

zh: summary: 開始純 Java 顏色追蹤（HSV 閾值＋最大 blob＋頭部 19/20 跟色）
en: summary: Start pure Java color tracking (HSV threshold + largest blob + head 19/20 follow the color)

zh: description: 零額外依賴（唔用 TFLite／OpenCV／ML Kit），離線可用。會自動開相機（若未開流），160x120 逐像素 HSV 閾值取最大色塊質心，死區＋步進驅動頭部 yaw/pitch。預設跟紅色（hue 335-25°）。同人臉追蹤互斥：啟動即停另一邊。播動作時請先停追蹤，兩邊同搶頭部舵機會打架。
en: description: Zero extra dependency (no TFLite, OpenCV, or ML Kit), usable offline. It opens the camera if the stream is not open, thresholds each pixel at 160x120 to take the largest color blob center, and a dead zone plus a step drive the head yaw and pitch. It follows red by default (hue 335-25). It is exclusive with face tracking, starting it stops the other. Stop the tracking before playing an action, or both fight over the head servos

zh: description: 檢測間隔 ms（預設 200；掃唔到用呢個；自動開且跟到色改用 trackIntervalMs）
en: description: Detection interval ms (default 200; used when nothing is found; a color found with auto open switches to trackIntervalMs)

zh: description: 跟到色時檢測間隔 ms（預設 100；僅自動開有效；實測單幀全圖 160x120 個位數 ms）
en: description: Detection interval ms when a color is found (default 100; only when auto open; a single full frame at 160x120 is single-digit ms in testing)

zh: description: 自動間隔（預設 true；開＝掃唔到慢掃、跟到快掃；關＝一律用 intervalMs）
en: description: Auto interval (default true; on = slow scan when nothing is found, fast scan when a color is found; off = always use intervalMs)

zh: description: 中央死區（歸一化半寬，預設 0.10；色塊質心在死區內不動頭）
en: description: Center dead zone (normalized half-width, default 0.10; a blob center inside the dead zone does not move the head)

zh: description: 目標色 hue 下限（度，預設 335；hMin>hMax 即 wrap 過 0°，如紅色 335-25）
en: description: Target color hue lower bound (degrees, default 335; hMin greater than hMax wraps over 0 degrees, such as red 335-25)

zh: description: 目標色 hue 上限（度，預設 25）
en: description: Target color hue upper bound (degrees, default 25)

zh: description: 飽和度下限（預設 0.45；去灰階背影）
en: description: Saturation lower bound (default 0.45; drops a gray background)

zh: description: 飽和度上限（預設 1.0 即不限；白色 preset 用 0.25 去彩色）
en: description: Saturation upper bound (default 1.0, unlimited; the white preset uses 0.25 to drop color)

zh: description: 明度下限（預設 0.25；去暗背影）
en: description: Brightness lower bound (default 0.25; drops a dark background)

zh: description: 明度上限（預設 1.0；調低可去白光反光）
en: description: Brightness upper bound (default 1.0; lowering it drops white glare)

zh: description: 最小色塊像素（160x120 圖上計，預設 80；細過即當掃唔到，去雜訊）
en: description: Min blob pixel count (counted on a 160x120 image, default 80; smaller counts as not found, drops noise)

zh: description: 行路跟總開關（預設 false；開＝偏就播轉向、遠就播前進一步、近就企定；淨播內建短步態，一次一動，掃唔到／停即唔發新步。平地＋清空＋有人睇住先開）
en: description: Walk-follow master switch (default false; on = play a turn when off to the side, a step forward when far, stand still when near; it plays only the built-in short gait, one action at a time, and does not send a new step when nothing is found or on stop. Open it on flat ground, cleared, with someone watching)

zh: description: 轉向死區（|dx| 超過先轉，預設 0.35；身體郁大步過頭，同頭死區分開）
en: description: Turn dead zone (turn only when the absolute dx is above it, default 0.35; the body moves bigger steps than the head, kept separate from the head dead zone)

zh: description: 夠近覆蓋率（色塊／全圖，預設 0.12；大過即企定唔行，淨個頭瞄）
en: description: Close-enough coverage (blob over full image, default 0.12; above it, stand still and do not walk, only the head aims)

zh: description: 前進一步動作（fileId／名／檔名，預設 1508999860568 前進）

A single send with no retry (retrying after the first send succeeded but the ACK was lost would hit the old ID for nothing). A timeout reports ok:false (sent but no reply, verify by moving with the new ID). Two servos on the same bus cannot share one ID

en: description: Zero extra dependency (no TFLite, OpenCV, or ML Kit), usable offline. It opens the camera if the stream is not open, thresholds each pixel at 160x120 to take the largest color blob center, and a dead zone plus a step drive the head yaw and pitch. It follows red by default (hue 335-25). It is exclusive with face tracking, starting it stops the other. Stop the tracking before playing an action, or both fight over the head servos
